title: Correct fall time
description: Essential: The response must correctly calculate the fall time as 2 s using free-fall kinematics.

title: Correct horizontal distance
description: Essential: The response must correctly calculate the horizontal distance as 4 m using horizontal motion.

title: Horizontal velocity maintained
description: Important: The response must state or apply that the ball retains the drone's horizontal velocity (2 m/s) after release.

title: Free-fall vertical motion
description: Important: The response must use correct vertical kinematics (e.g., h = ½gt²) to find the fall time.

title: Units included
description: Optional: The final numerical answers should include correct units (s and m).

title: Incorrect horizontal acceleration
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the response assumes horizontal acceleration or deceleration after release.

title: Sign or formula error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the response uses an incorrect kinematic formula (e.g., v = gt for distance) or sign error in vertical motion.
